## 2. Authentication Chain Classes (HMAC and JWT)

### 2a. HMAC Authentication Chain (3 source files + 1 filter)

**Package: `com.maritime.platform.gateway.security.hmac`**

All four classes are `@Component` and conditionally enabled via `@ConditionalOnProperty("maritime.gateway.security.hmac.enabled")`.

**(a) `HmacAuthenticationManager`**
- File: `/Users/raymond/.dora/orchestrator/worktrees/maritime-platform/20260525A/platform-gateway-starter/src/main/java/com/maritime/platform/gateway/security/hmac/HmacAuthenticationManager.java`
- Entry point for HMAC auth. Signature:

```java
public Mono<GatewayPrincipal.App> authenticate(String appKey, String timestamp,
        String nonce, String clientDigest, String clientSig,
        String method, String rawPath, String rawQuery, byte[] bodyBytes)
```

- Validation sequence (6 steps):
  1. Validate timestamp is within `timestamp-tolerance` window (default 5min)
  2. Validate nonce length >= `min-nonce-length` (default 16 chars)
  3. Compute SHA-256 of body bytes, constant-time compare with client digest
  4. Validate nonce (delegates to `HmacNonceValidator` for Redis SETNX)
  5. Build canonical request string via `HmacCanonicalRequestBuilder`
  6. Resolve app secret from config, compute HMAC-SHA256, constant-time compare with client sig
- Returns `Mono<GatewayPrincipal.App>` on success
- Resolves app secrets from `properties.getHmac().getCredentials().getApps()` (config-based flat list)
- Static utility methods: `sha256Hex()`, `hmacSha256Hex()`, `constantTimeEquals()`

- File: `/Users/raymond/.dora/orchestrator/worktrees/maritime-platform/20260525A/platform-gateway-starter/src/main/java/com/maritime/platform/gateway/security/hmac/HmacCanonicalRequestBuilder.java`

  {appKey}
  {UPPERCASE_METHOD}
  {rawPath}
  {canonicalQuery}
  {timestamp}
  {nonce}
  {bodyDigest}
  ```
- Query parameters are URL-decoded, sorted by key (then by value order for duplicate keys), and re-encoded (spaces as `%20`, not `+`)
- Method is normalized to uppercase

**(c) `HmacNonceValidator`**
- File: `/Users/raymond/.dora/orchestrator/worktrees/maritime-platform/20260525A/platform-gateway-starter/src/main/java/com/maritime/platform/gateway/security/hmac/HmacNonceValidator.java`
